# Best Spa Rawalpindi

> Luxury spa and massage center in Bahria Town Phase 7, Rawalpindi, Pakistan (near Nando's & Wallayat Complex). Certified male and female therapists, private suites, and transparent PKR pricing. Phone/WhatsApp: +92 306 5656413. Open Mon–Fri 10:00 AM – 4:40 AM, Sat & Sun 24 hours.

Best Spa Rawalpindi offers Swedish, deep tissue, Thai, full body, aromatherapy, hot stone, foot reflexology and couples massage. It serves Bahria Town, DHA Islamabad, PWD, Rawalpindi Cantt and the wider Rawalpindi–Islamabad area. Email: info@bestsparawalpindi.com. Address: Bahria Town Phase 7, Near Nando's & Wallayat Complex, Rawalpindi, Punjab 46000, Pakistan.
